notes.title: Fantastic World of Mahjong Princess - Patch v2.1.1
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback and support. In order to provide a better game experience, the team has adjusted some content.
Here is the changelog:

[list]
[*] The function adds the function of choosing the difficulty of the game, which can be adjusted at any time in the game.
[*] Adjusted the amount of funds raised when playing cards in the final gate and hidden gate.
[*] Fixed the problem that the game freezes when skipping HCG.
[/list]

tags.feature: The function adds the function of choosing the difficulty of the game, which can be adjusted at any time in the game.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the amount of funds raised when playing cards in the final gate and hidden gate.

tags.bug: Fixed the problem that the game freezes when skipping HCG.
